# Musical Trip Planner

> A free web app for planning musical-theatre trips to London (West End) and New York (Broadway). Pick a city and trip dates; the planner fetches the live performance schedule for those dates, shows only musicals playing each day, and lets you choose a matinee and an evening performance each day, plus morning, early-evening (17:00–18:29) or late shows on days that have them. It shows theatre names and addresses, links to ticket sellers, and exports the itinerary to PDF or Excel. It is not a ticket seller.

- Site: https://musicaltripplanner.com/
- Cities: London · West End; New York · Broadway
- Rules: matinee = start before 17:00; evening = 17:00 or later; max one of each per date
- Data: live schedules scraped per date from public theatre listings; ticket links go to third-party sellers (SeatPlan and venue box offices)
- Privacy: planner state stays in the visitor's browser; no accounts
- Contact: info@musicaltripplanner.com
